nodes.asset_description: A man wearing sunglasses and a gray jacket stands with his right hand clenched, facing left. Behind him, a cityscape is visible at sunset, with a bright orange glow emanating from behind him. Dark, fragmented pieces are scattered across the transparent background, primarily concentrated behind and to the right of the man.
